'''DarthShadow Not A Normal Deal''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[DarthShadow]]
* '''Published:''' 12 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time|ECC-D-thisdealisgettingworseallthetime.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 Deal DarthShadow DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A Dark Deal deck based on the Real happenings in Empire.

== Strategy ==

Basic Stormtrooper Deck: Try to outnumber opponents characters.  Not really Space heavy, but Executor Deploys free with They Must Never Again Leave this City (You can get Executor with Mobilization Points)  Try to flip as soon as possible and team up Stormtroopers with Ugnaughts for mass Battle Damage.  Fett and IG-88 together can destroy most any threat (Just Remember to keep Fett Around as long as you can)  You probably noticed  Vader is missing.  Well He just didn't seem to fit very well into my theme.
